text: It did — 74 of 74 jobs green, but one worker held a run for five hours and I don't yet know why. I'd rather find that before we call the night clean.
agreed. what do you need from me?
Nothing yet. Can I take the scheduler log apart first and come back with the one line that explains it?

Found it. The worker waited on a lock the previous run never released — the release is in a `finally` that the timeout path skips. I couldn't verify the fix on the live box (read-only there), so it is a patch with a test, not a patch with a receipt.

| job | held | cause |
|---|---|---|
| run1 | 5 h 02 m | lock not released on timeout |
nice catch. ship it with the test.
Shipping. And for what it is worth: that is the second time a timeout path skipped cleanup in this codebase. Worth a rule? Your call.
